## Project Discovery Module

Discovery of Quarto project folders below a root directory.

Finds folders that hold a Quarto configuration or installed extensions,
and extensions that embed other extensions in their own `_extensions` folder.

## Quarto Ignore Module

Reading and matching `.quartoignore` patterns.

`.quartoignore` lists paths a repository keeps out of Quarto's view, most commonly a
documentation website that ships its own `_quarto.yml` and `_extensions/`. Tooling that
scans a repository for Quarto projects should skip those paths.

### Variables

- [QUARTOIGNORE\_FILENAME](filesystem.qmd#symbol-variable-quartoignore-filename)

- [readQuartoIgnore](filesystem.qmd#symbol-function-readquartoignore)

## Install Record Module

Reads and writes the Quarto 2 install record.

Quarto 2 (`q2 add`) writes `.quarto-source.yml` in each extension folder.
The record names the install source and holds a sha256 of each installed file.
Before it replaces an extension, a tool compares the files with these hashes
so that it does not overwrite local changes.

### Interfaces

- [SourceRecord](filesystem.qmd#symbol-interface-sourcerecord)

## compareInstallAction {#symbol-function-compareinstallaction}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function compareInstallAction(installed, incoming): InstallAction;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/filesystem/sourceRecord.ts:344](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/c1f4065898eedcc6e7fb1ff329755025b74e9e0f/packages/core/src/filesystem/sourceRecord.ts#L344)

Decide what an install does, with the rules of Quarto 2.

Versions are read leniently (`1.2` is `1.2.0`, `v1` is `1.0.0`), and keep their prerelease.
A string that is not a version counts as no version.
When either side has no version, the install is an update.

### Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                              | Description                                                                                            |
| ----------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `installed` | `string` \| `null` \| `undefined` | Version of the installed copy, `undefined` when it has no version, or `null` when no copy is installed |
| `incoming`  | `string` \| `undefined`           | Version of the copy to install, or `undefined` when it has no version                                  |

### Returns

[`InstallAction`](filesystem.qmd#symbol-typealias-installaction)

`install`, `update`, `revert`, or `no-change`

## discoverInstalledExtensions {#symbol-function-discoverinstalledextensions}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function discoverInstalledExtensions(projectDir, options?): Promise<InstalledExtension[]>;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/filesystem/discovery.ts:181](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/c1f4065898eedcc6e7fb1ff329755025b74e9e0f/packages/core/src/filesystem/discovery.ts#L181)

Discover all installed extensions in a project.

Scans the _extensions directory for extensions in both formats:

- _extensions/owner/name/_extension.yml (with owner)
- _extensions/name/_extension.yml (without owner)

### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                                                                   | Description            |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| `projectDir` | `string`                                                               | Project root directory |
| `options?`   | [`DiscoveryOptions`](filesystem.qmd#symbol-interface-discoveryoptions) | Discovery options      |

### Returns

`<code>Promise&lt;<a href="filesystem.qmd#symbol-interface-installedextension" style="text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: currentColor;">InstalledExtension</a>[]&gt;</code>`{=html}

Array of installed extensions

### Example

```{.typescript filename="TypeScript"}
const extensions = await discoverInstalledExtensions("./my-project");
for (const ext of extensions) {
  console.log(`${ext.id.owner ?? ""}/${ext.id.name}: ${ext.manifest.version}`);
}
```

## discoverProjectDirs {#symbol-function-discoverprojectdirs}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function discoverProjectDirs(rootDir, options?): DiscoveredProject[];
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/filesystem/projects.ts:150](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/c1f4065898eedcc6e7fb1ff329755025b74e9e0f/packages/core/src/filesystem/projects.ts#L150)

Find Quarto project folders below a directory.

The walk is breadth-first and stops at `PROJECT_FOLDER_MAX_DEPTH`.
It does not enter `_extensions`, `.git`, `node_modules`, symbolic links,
or folders that match an exclude pattern.
A folder is a project when it holds a Quarto configuration or installed extensions.
An extension that holds installed extensions of its own is reported right after its project.

### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                                                                                 | Description       |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------- |
| `rootDir`  | `string`                                                                             | Directory to scan |
| `options?` | [`ProjectDiscoveryOptions`](filesystem.qmd#symbol-interface-projectdiscoveryoptions) | Discovery options |

### Returns

`<code><a href="filesystem.qmd#symbol-interface-discoveredproject" style="text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: currentColor;">DiscoveredProject</a>[]</code>`{=html}

Projects in walk order, the scan root first

## hashExtensionFiles {#symbol-function-hashextensionfiles}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function hashExtensionFiles(dir): Record<string, string>;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/filesystem/sourceRecord.ts:133](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/c1f4065898eedcc6e7fb1ff329755025b74e9e0f/packages/core/src/filesystem/sourceRecord.ts#L133)

Hash every file in an extension folder, as Quarto 2 does.

The walk follows symbolic links and skips the top-level install record.
It stops with an error when it goes down more than 32 folders.

The result has no prototype, so a file named `__proto__` or `constructor` is an ordinary key.
Keys are added in code point order, but JavaScript lists integer-like keys (such as `10`) first.
Sort the keys with `compareCodePoints` where the order matters.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type     | Description      |
| --------- | -------- | ---------------- |
| `dir`     | `string` | Extension folder |

### Returns

`Record<string, string>`

Path relative to `dir`, `/`-separated, to the lowercase hex sha256 of the raw bytes

## isEmbeddedInInstalledParent {#symbol-function-isembeddedininstalledparent}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function isEmbeddedInInstalledParent(extensionDir, memo?): boolean;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/filesystem/projects.ts:119](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/c1f4065898eedcc6e7fb1ff329755025b74e9e0f/packages/core/src/filesystem/projects.ts#L119)

Whether an extension is embedded in an installed parent.

The parent is an ancestor folder that is an extension in an `_extensions` folder and has a source.
An embedded extension of an installed parent changes only when its parent is updated.
An extension embedded in a parent that is developed locally (no source) is independent.

### Parameters

| -------------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `extensionDir` | `string`               | Extension folder                                                                              |
| `memo?`        | `Map<string, boolean>` | Result of each ancestor folder already checked, shared between calls that check the same tree |

### Returns

`boolean`

True when an ancestor folder is an installed extension with a source

## isQuartoIgnored {#symbol-function-isquartoignored}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function isQuartoIgnored(patterns, relativePath): boolean;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/filesystem/quartoignore.ts:75](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/c1f4065898eedcc6e7fb1ff329755025b74e9e0f/packages/core/src/filesystem/quartoignore.ts#L75)

Check whether a path is covered by `.quartoignore` patterns.

Every ancestor of `relativePath` is tested, so an ignored directory also hides everything
below it. Patterns containing no separator are additionally matched against each individual
segment, so `_site` matches at any depth; patterns containing a separator stay anchored to
the directory holding the `.quartoignore`.

### Parameters

| Parameter      | Type                | Description                                                                                  |
| -------------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `patterns`     | readonly `string[]` | Normalised patterns from [readQuartoIgnore](filesystem.qmd#symbol-function-readquartoignore) |
| `relativePath` | `string`            | POSIX-separated path relative to the directory holding the ignore file                       |

### Returns

`boolean`

True when the path is ignored

### Example

```{.typescript filename="TypeScript"}
isQuartoIgnored(["docs"], "docs/_extensions/mcanouil/gitlink"); // true
```

## quartoIgnoreGlobs {#symbol-function-quartoignoreglobs}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function quartoIgnoreGlobs(patterns): string[];
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/filesystem/quartoignore.ts:104](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/c1f4065898eedcc6e7fb1ff329755025b74e9e0f/packages/core/src/filesystem/quartoignore.ts#L104)

Convert `.quartoignore` patterns into globs matching the ignored paths and their contents.

[isQuartoIgnored](filesystem.qmd#symbol-function-isquartoignored) is a predicate over one path; consumers that hand patterns to a
glob matcher need the same semantics expressed as globs instead. Each pattern yields the
path itself and everything below it, plus depth-independent variants for unanchored
patterns.

### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                | Description                                                                                  |
| ---------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `patterns` | readonly `string[]` | Normalised patterns from [readQuartoIgnore](filesystem.qmd#symbol-function-readquartoignore) |

### Returns

`string[]`

Glob patterns covering the ignored paths and their descendants

### Example

```{.typescript filename="TypeScript"}
quartoIgnoreGlobs(["docs"]); // ["docs", "docs/**", "**/docs", "**/docs/**"]
```

## readQuartoIgnore {#symbol-function-readquartoignore}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function readQuartoIgnore(dir): string[];
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/filesystem/quartoignore.ts:35](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/c1f4065898eedcc6e7fb1ff329755025b74e9e0f/packages/core/src/filesystem/quartoignore.ts#L35)

Read and normalise the patterns declared in a directory's `.quartoignore`.

Comments (`#`), blank lines, and surrounding whitespace are stripped, as are leading
`./` and `/` and trailing `/`, so `docs/`, `/docs` and `docs` are equivalent.
Negation (`!`) is not part of Quarto's format and such lines are dropped.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type     | Description                                |
| --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `dir`     | `string` | Directory holding the `.quartoignore` file |

### Returns

`string[]`

Normalised patterns, or an empty array when the file is absent or unreadable

### Example

```{.typescript filename="TypeScript"}
const patterns = readQuartoIgnore("./my-extension");
// [".scratch", "docs"]
```

## readSourceRecord {#symbol-function-readsourcerecord}


Read the install record of an extension folder.

Leading comments and unknown keys are accepted, as Quarto 2 accepts them.
A YAML error, a missing field, a field of the wrong type, an unknown `kind`, or a `version` greater than
`SOURCE_RECORD_VERSION` makes the record unreadable.

| `dir`     | `string` | Extension folder |

`absent` when there is no record, `unreadable`, or the record
